comment: He is a good guy and class itself was easy, just had to do readings and then had to participate in class with a few projects and essays throughout. little feedback on assignments

Remarkable boring class. He weights the finals way too much and they have nothing to do with anything we talk about in class. The finals felt like my AP Lang exam from high school again. Irrelevant and frustrating - he's very stubborn as well.
Very hard grader, a lot of his comments are subjective. He is a really great guy though and has insightful discussions.
He is awesome! Just a great person overall. He wants you to succeed, and his class conversations are insightful. He is a very tough grader, but he provides very clear and constructive feedback.
Professor Achter is a great teacher and cares a lot about his students. His class is very entertaining and enjoyable. However, your grade is based off of 3 papers and he tends to grade them harshly.

Dr. Achter always made class interesting with his lectures and he lightened up the class with his jokes and analogies. However, Dr. Achter is an extremely difficult grader and does not give any feedback on his grading which makes it hard to know what you did wrong/ why you received the grade that you did.

We switched professors after spring break after the first had a fall, and that was the best thing that could've happened. Dr. Achter is amazing, he makes class fun and is a fair grader. Wanted to show up to class and pay attention for once. Gave a detailed study guide for the exam and clear directions for the final paper. Take him if you can!!
Took the wire FYS with him. Phenomenal class, both him and Simpson are fun and incredibly smart.
Great professor! Definitely helps if you are interested in the topic, he loves participation and passion--- readings are a must if you want a good grade, but you can get by just skimming them.

Some days I loved him and some days I hated him. You have to go to class (he takes attendance every time), but the content really isn't hard. As far as his grading system goes it's basically this: easy to get a B, REALLY hard to get an A. I would recommend taking him; he's passionate about what he teaches and does want his students to do well.
Achter is a great guy, and a really good professor. He's tough, especially when grading writing assignments. Take his class if you want to learn a lot, not juet get a good grade
Hard class, but worthwhile. I recommend him to my friends.
ACHTER IS A TERRIBLE TEACHER. he is arrogant and rude.  someone should give that man a reality check.
Very interesting and useful class.
He has his favorites...if you aren't one of them, you are screwed...
Achter is cool as poo (s@#t). He lectures for most of the class, which can get kind of boring. However, he talks about interesting stuff and he is a chill dude

I loved this class. Dr. Achter is engaging, and ensures that everyone in the class participates. He's very open-minded but not afraid to disagree with students, challenging them to respond truthfully and earnestly to the course material. That said, as a 101 class, the emphasis seemed less on the art of public speaking and more on general rhetoric.
Easily one of the best professors I've had at Richmond. Definitely very hard but why take a 413 level class if you don't expect it to be challenging?
Great prof! Knows a lot, is enthusiastic, and made it worth attending class. These other people must have gotten bad grades.
New to UR!!  An intro class was definately not supposed to be this hard.  He  has to prove his ability to teach here.  He was a really nice guy but teacher wise rather difficult!
Dr. Achter was a really nice guy, but unbelievably difficult, trying to prove himself in the department which is ridiculous. Nice guy, not understanding of any students' needs.
